guide.title: Atlanta Bakeries from Buford Highway to the Westside
guide.author: friends of Placemoir
guide.summary: Twenty Atlanta bakeries worth a detour, from sourdough and croissants in Poncey-Highland to egg tarts, banh mi and conchas on Buford Highway, plus doughnuts, bagels and pie.

places.name: The Little Tart Bakeshop
places.address: 437 Memorial Dr SE, Atlanta, GA 30312
places.notes: The first Little Tart shop, opened in 2011 on Memorial Drive in Grant Park. Seasonal fruit tarts, laminated pastries and quiche. There are also counters at Krog Street Market and in Summerhill.

places.name: Colette Bread & Bakeshop
places.address: 636 N Highland Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30306
places.notes: A small bread-first bakery in Poncey-Highland. Go for the naturally leavened loaves and focaccia, then add a croissant or a fruit galette. Popular items go early on weekends.

places.name: Alon's Bakery & Market
places.address: 1394 N Highland Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30306
places.notes: A Morningside institution for decades, with a bread and pastry counter beside a market of cheeses and prepared foods. Pick up a loaf and a sandwich for a picnic. A second shop is at Phipps Plaza.

places.name: Evergreen Butcher + Baker
places.address: 2011 Hosea L Williams Dr NE, Atlanta, GA 30317
places.notes: Half butcher shop, half bakery, on Hosea L Williams Drive in Kirkwood. Come for the sourdough and the pastry case, and leave with something from the meat counter. Closed early in the week; check the official site.

places.name: Emerald City Bagels
places.address: 1257 Glenwood Ave SE, Atlanta, GA 30316
places.notes: Kettle-boiled New York-style bagels in East Atlanta Village, with a long list of house cream cheeses and lox. A second shop sits on the Eastside BeltLine on Auburn Avenue.

places.name: Flour + Time Bakery
places.address: 1133 Huff Rd NW, Suite F, Atlanta, GA 30318
places.notes: A fully vegan bakery and coffee shop on Huff Road where the croissants and laminated pastries hold their own against any butter-based shop. Things sell out, so come early.

places.name: Saint Germain French Bakery & Cafe
places.address: 1115 Howell Mill Rd NW, Suite 372, Atlanta, GA 30318
places.notes: A French-style bakery and cafe at The Interlock with classic viennoiserie, eclairs and fruit tarts. A good spot for a croissant and coffee on a Westside afternoon.

places.name: Henri's Bakery & Deli
places.address: 56 E Andrews Dr NW, Atlanta, GA 30305
places.notes: A bakery and deli with roots in 1929 Atlanta, now in Andrews Square. Known for po'boys on its own bread, plus cookies, pastries and decorated cakes.

places.name: Southern Baked Pie Company
places.address: 3145 Peachtree Rd NE, Suite 165, Atlanta, GA 30305
places.notes: A Georgia pie company with its roots in Gainesville. Sweet pies like pecan and chess sit next to savory pot pies, by the slice or whole. A second intown shop is in Vinings.

places.name: International Bakery
places.address: 2165 Cheshire Bridge Rd NE, Suite 5, Atlanta, GA 30324
places.notes: A Greek family bakery in a Cheshire Bridge strip center. Baklava, honey cookies, spanakopita and celebration cakes, plus a few shelves of Greek groceries.

places.name: Southern Sweets Bakery
places.address: 186 Rio Cir, Decatur, GA 30030
places.notes: A Decatur bakery that started out supplying cakes and pies to restaurants. Layer cakes, tarts and pies, with vegan and gluten-free versions, and a small breakfast and lunch menu.

places.name: Revolution Doughnuts
places.address: 908 W College Ave, Decatur, GA 30030
places.notes: Small-batch doughnuts in a little Decatur shop, with rotating flavors and options for vegans and those avoiding gluten, eggs or dairy. A second shop is on Edgewood Avenue in Inman Park.

places.name: Galette
places.address: 110 N Avondale Rd, Avondale Estates, GA 30002
places.notes: A small bakery in the Tudor-style downtown of Avondale Estates. French-American pastry and naturally fermented bread, including the namesake rustic tarts. Open only part of the week; check before you go.

places.name: Lee's Bakery
places.address: 4005 Buford Hwy NE, Suite C, Atlanta, GA 30345
places.notes: A no-frills Vietnamese bakery known for banh mi on baguettes baked in-house. The grilled pork is the usual order. Closed Mondays.

places.name: Family Baking
places.address: 5389 New Peachtree Rd, Suite E, Chamblee, GA 30341
places.notes: A Hong Kong-style bakery in the Chinatown center in Chamblee. Warm egg tarts by the door, pineapple buns, and baked and steamed buns filled with roast pork or red bean.

places.name: Sweet Hut Bakery & Cafe
places.address: 5150 Buford Hwy NE, Suite A-100, Doraville, GA 30340
places.notes: The Buford Highway Sweet Hut, where the bakery and tea shop got its start in 2012, open into the evening. Egg tarts, cakes and sweet buns, plus milk teas and savory snacks.

places.name: Panaderia Del Valle
places.address: 5781 Buford Hwy NE, Suite 105, Doraville, GA 30340
places.notes: A family-run Mexican panaderia on Buford Highway since 2006. Take a tray and tongs and fill up on conchas, cuernos and empanadas from the open cases.

places.name: White Windmill Bakery & Cafe
places.address: 5881 Buford Hwy NE, Doraville, GA 30340
places.notes: The Doraville flagship of a Korean-French bakery with a few locations around town. Red bean and sweet potato buns, cream breads and soft sponge cakes, plus a seating area for coffee.

places.name: The Bronx Bagel Buggy
places.address: 5494 Peachtree Rd, Chamblee, GA 30341
places.notes: A farmers market bagel stand turned Chamblee storefront, making chewy New York-style bagels and deli sandwiches. Open only a few days a week and lines form, so check the schedule first.

places.name: Mozart Bakery
places.address: 5301 Buford Hwy NE, Doraville, GA 30340
places.notes: A Korean-style bakery cafe with a big dining room. Strawberry cream cakes, macarons and European-style breads, and a good place to sit with a coffee between Buford Highway stops.
